description: This PHP source file defines the CustomerProfilesClient class within the Aws\CustomerProfiles namespace. It extends the AwsClient class and serves as a client interface to interact with Amazon Connect Customer Profiles service, providing method annotations for available API calls and their asynchronous counterparts.

classes.name: CustomerProfilesClient
